summary.headline: Juniper Green Q2 FY27 total income rose 2.3x YoY to INR 372 crores and EBITDA 2.6x to INR 340 crores, a record, at a 91.4% margin.
summary.overview: Management reported a second consecutive record quarter, with total income of INR 372 crores (up 15% QoQ) and EBITDA of INR 340 crores (91.4% margin). Generation rose 127% YoY to 1,130 million units, with fleet CUF at 27% versus 21% a year earlier, and wind delivered 50% weighted CUF. Operational capacity reached 2.8 GWp plus 600 MWh BESS, with FY27 guidance of 2 GWp and 1.7 GWh BESS reiterated. Capex for the quarter was about INR 2,600 crores, and net debt to net worth improved to 2.22x after IPO proceeds, with ICRA upgrading the company to AA- stable.

segments.name: Solar and wind generation (fleet)
segments.commentary: Q2 generation 1,130 MU (+127% YoY); fleet CUF 27% vs 21%. H1 generation 2,075 MU (+98%), H1 CUF 28.5% vs 24.1%. Wind weighted CUF 50% vs 41.3%; Juniper Green Beam (50 MW) at 58.3% CUF.

segments.name: BESS
segments.commentary: About 100 MWh commissioned in Q2; about 500 MWh commissioned in first 7 months of FY27, taking operational BESS to 600 MWh. Operating assets report SOH above 99% and RTE near 90%.

guidance_outlook: FY27 commissioning guidance reiterated: 2 GWp generation capacity and 1.7 GWh BESS; about 3.9 GWp expected by March 2027.
EBITDA run rate: about INR 1,900 crores for the 2.8 GWp commissioned today; about INR 2,750 crores for the ~3.9 GWp expected by March 2027.
Total capex expected at about INR 24,000 crores by FY27 end, implying about INR 5,000 crores more in H2 on top of INR 19,000 crores cumulative to date.
Operational net debt expected to be close to INR 9,000 crores.
BESS installation targeted at about 4.5 GWh by June 2027 and 10 GWh by March 2028.
Projects slated for FY28 commissioning have dates not beyond June 2027 per management, about 6-9 months later than original dates.
About 1 to 1.3 GWp of the earlier ~4 GWp LOAs expected to convert to PSA/PPA within 1 to 1.5 months; thermal mimic PPA timing dependent on DISCOM selection.
capex_capacity: Operational capacity 2.8 GWp plus 600 MWh BESS across 11 sites in 3 states; 7-month FY27 additions of 494 MWp solar, 542 MW wind and about 500 MWh BESS.
Q2 commissioning about 316 MWp renewable plus about 100 MWh BESS, in line with 250-300 MWp guidance; total portfolio about 11.2 GWp plus 9 GWh BESS, of which 6.1 GWp operational or PPA-signed.
Envision E-182 turbines (5 MW, 181 m rotor, 130 m hub) — about 51 units commissioned.
Gross block INR 12,250 crores; CWIP incl. advances INR 6,600 crores; cumulative capex about INR 19,000 crores; H1 capex INR 3,800 crores.
Beta project: about 1,300 MWh merchant battery; about half expected operational by March 2027. Stellar project running on T-GNA; final line (Fatehgarh 3-Bhadla 3) expected December 2026.
demand_pricing: India power demand grew 10.2% in H1 FY27; management says standalone BESS arbitrage expected to continue as standalone BESS tenders have not materialised.
Q2 curtailment about 2.5% of revenue, concentrated in July-August before Stellar lines were completed; none in September-October per management, with batteries absorbing residual curtailment.
Battery prices expected to soften about 1-2% (from about INR 68-70 to INR 66-68 range) after China removed export incentive from January.
Non-DCR modules at about INR 12 or lower; DCR modules: SECI procurement at about INR 18, expected to be INR 18 or below in about a year.
Portfolio 86% contracted with central agencies (SJVN, NHPC, NTPC, SECI, GUVNL); 98% with offtakers rated A or above; 98% under long-term PPAs (typically 25 years); DSO 25 days.
Thermal mimic tender won: 230 MW contracted capacity, plan for 530 MW solar (1.5 DC ratio, ~790 MW DC), 75 MW wind and ~2.2 GWh BESS; management targets mid-to-high teens returns.

qa_highlights.question: Transmission risk, especially Juniper Green Stellar and Beta timelines?
qa_highlights.answer: Stellar runs on T-GNA with one line (Fatehgarh 3-Bhadla 3, built by Apraava) expected in December 2026; Beta about half of its 1,300 MWh merchant battery expected by March 2027, with management confident of no curtailment even if slipping a couple of months.

qa_highlights.question: Operational net debt, Q2 CUF and capex plan for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Operational net debt close to INR 9,000 crores; Q2 CUF 27% and H1 28.5%; total capex to reach about INR 24,000 crores by FY27 end, with about INR 5,000 crores more in H2.

qa_highlights.question: Current EBITDA run rate and LOA-to-PPA conversion status?
qa_highlights.answer: Run rate about INR 1,900 crores for 2.8 GWp, rising to INR 2,750 crores for 3.9 GWp by March 2027. About 1-1.3 GWp of the earlier 4 GWp LOAs expected to move to PSA/PPA signing within 1-1.5 months; thermal mimic PPA delayed while DISCOMs select entities.

qa_highlights.question: Will FY28 projects avoid transmission delays and reach an EBITDA run rate of INR 4,300-4,400 crores by FY28-end?
qa_highlights.answer: Management did not give green shoots but said FY28 projects' transmission dates are no later than June 2027, 6-9 months behind original, and STU capacity is not hit by such delays, so it expects continued capacity expansion.

qa_highlights.question: Other income: components and sustainability?
qa_highlights.answer: Mainly interest on surplus funds, with cash of INR 2,000 crores at 30 September; this income falls as cash is deployed into capex.

qa_highlights.question: Bidding strategy and return thresholds?
qa_highlights.answer: Management targets mid-to-high teens returns; it will skip aggressive solar-only tenders but bid tenders with batteries; standalone BESS bids on hold until tariffs correct.

qa_highlights.question: Thermal mimic returns and whether such tenders will recur?
qa_highlights.answer: Returns mid-to-high teens, versus about 20% on earlier 2023-24 FDRE bids that benefited from higher battery costs; management expects more such tenders.

risks_watch: Transmission delays: FY28 projects' lines already slipped 6-9 months; any further slip could push commissioning beyond June 2027.
LOA-to-PPA conversion: about 1-1.3 GWp expected in 1-1.5 months and thermal mimic PPA timing depends on DISCOM choice; watch signing.
Curtailment: Q2 about 2.5% of revenue; management says it has eased since September but depends on Stellar line completion and battery absorption.
Merchant BESS exposure: some batteries sold on short-tenor (1-6 month) DISCOM tenders until long-term PPAs are signed.
Other income is likely to decline as surplus cash is deployed into capex.
Battery and DCR module price trends and softening, as well as slower standalone BESS tendering.
summary.management_tone: Confident on operations and guidance, with specific numbers given readily. More guarded on transmission timelines and thermal mimic PPA conversion, where management avoided firm dates and said conversion was taking longer.
key_quotes: Q2 FY27 was another record quarter for us.
we are well placed to install close to 4.5 gigawatt-hours of BESS by June '27 and 10 gigawatt-hours by March '28.
Returns are important for us. We look at mid-to-high teens, right.

adds.what: 2 GWp generation capacity for FY27 (about 3.9 GWp peak expected by March 2027)
BESS to 1.7 GWh in FY27, about 4.5 GWh by June 2027 and 10 GWh by March 2028
Beta project about 1,300 MWh merchant battery, about half operational by March 2027
Thermal mimic project: 530 MW solar, 75 MW wind, ~2.2 GWh BESS (230 MW contracted)

growth.why: Management reiterated FY27 commissioning of 2 GWp and 1.7 GWh BESS (about 3.9 GWp by March 2027, EBITDA run rate INR 2,750 crores), backed by ~316 MWp commissioned in Q2, 6.1 GWp operational or PPA-signed, and INR 5,000 crores of further H2 capex, though some FY28 projects slipped 6-9 months.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: EBITDA run rate rises from about INR 1,900 crores on 2.8 GWp today to about INR 2,750 crores on about 3.9 GWp by March 2027, while Q2 EBITDA margin was already 91.4%; batteries absorbing curtailment and lower battery prices (INR 68-70 to 66-68) help.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: FY27 guidance of 2 GWp and 1.7 GWh BESS reiterated, with about 3.9 GWp by March 2027 and about 316 MWp plus 100 MWh commissioned in Q2, but FY28 projects slipped 6-9 months on transmission and Stellar's final line is only due December 2026.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Fleet CUF rose to 27% from 21% and H1 generation grew 98% to 2,075 MU, and capacity rises from 2.8 GWp to about 3.9 GWp by March 2027.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Capex is already under way: INR 19,000 crores cumulative with about INR 5,000 crores more planned in H2 to reach INR 24,000 crores by FY27 end, and the thermal mimic project (530 MW solar, 75 MW wind, ~2.2 GWh BESS) is approved.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 commissioning guidance was held rather than raised, and ICRA upgraded to AA- stable, but transmission delays and thermal mimic PPA timing are the open risks.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Management flagged FY28 projects slipping 6-9 months and an unknown DISCOM selection timeline for thermal mimic PPAs, and any further transmission slip could push commissioning past June 2027.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: BESS scales from 600 MWh to about 4.5 GWh by June 2027 and 10 GWh by March 2028, and the thermal mimic (~2.2 GWh BESS, 530 MW solar) is approved for a Q4 FY27 start, though these are storage and capacity rather than new products.

rows.label: LOA-to-PSA/PPA conversion of 1-1.3 GWp
rows.why: Management expects about 1-1.3 GWp of the earlier ~4 GWp LOAs to convert to PSA/PPA within 1 to 1.5 months, though the thermal mimic PPA is delayed pending DISCOM selection.

rows.label: Lower battery and module costs
rows.why: Battery prices expected to soften about 1-2% (INR 68-70 to 66-68) after China removed its export incentive, and SECI DCR module procurement is around INR 18, expected to be INR 18 or below in about a year.

rows.label: Net debt to net worth falls after IPO
rows.why: Net debt to net worth improved to 2.22x (net debt INR 11,600 crores over net worth INR 5,200 crores) after INR 1,800 crores of primary IPO proceeds, and the cost of debt fell to 8.46% from 8.58%.

tone.note: Management was confident on generation, CUF and the reiterated FY27 commissioning and EBITDA run rate, but cautious on transmission timelines for FY28 projects and on thermal mimic PPA conversion, which it said was taking longer. Analysts pushed on FY28 EBITDA targets and the transmission slippage.
